items.title: 290 North Beacon arts and community space public meeting
items.summary: The Boston Housing Authority and the Mayor's Office of Arts and Culture will share progress on turning 290 North Beacon in Brighton into a music, arts and community space, including a pilot opportunity, and take questions. Attend either session (Oct 29 at 6 p.m. or Oct 30 at 12 p.m.); both cover the same information.

contacts.name: Rahul Ramesh
contacts.office: Boston Housing Authority / Mayor's Office of Arts and Culture
